deleteAccountPage.heading: Delete Your Qaddam Account
deleteAccountPage.subtitle: You can request account deletion here even without the app — verify your phone number and we'll take it from there.

policy.title: What happens when you request deletion
steps: Verify your phone number with a one-time code to file the request.
An admin reviews the request before anything happens to your account.
If approved, your account is deactivated during a short cancellation window.
Once the window closes, your data is permanently erased.
policy.windowNote: Signing back in during the {{days}}-day window cancels the deletion and restores your account.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.helper: This must be the phone number on your Qaddam account. We'll text you a 6-digit code to verify it's you.
phone.invalid: Enter a valid Saudi phone number, e.g. +966501234567

otp.title: Enter verification code
otp.description: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {{phone}}.
otp.label: Verification code

success.title: Request received
success.description: Your account deletion request has been submitted and is now pending admin review.
success.note: Keep this reference for your records. If your request is approved, your account will be deactivated, then permanently deleted after the cancellation window ends.

check.description: Already submitted a request? Enter your reference number and the phone number you verified with to check its status or cancel it.
check.referenceInvalid: Enter the reference number from your confirmation
check.cancelConfirm: Cancel this deletion request? Your account will stay active and nothing will be deleted.
check.cancelledNotice: This request has been cancelled. Your account is safe.
